Build the full merger dataset

Source: R/pipeline.R
build_merger_data.Rd

Runs the whole pipeline: Schedule N retrieval, EIN recovery, filing-level features, merger evidence, classification, merger cases, transfer values, donor and recipient attributes, the Part VII panel, and the fiscal panel. Every stage is also available as its own function.

Usage

build_merger_data(
  years = NULL,
  path = "PANEL990",
  rules = merger_rules(),
  types = c("merger2", "mergerN", "consolidation"),
  recover_eins = TRUE,
  pre = 5L,
  post = 5L,
  years_back = 4L,
  ratios = TRUE,
  fit = NULL,
  weights = NULL,
  smooth = c("none", "trailing"),
  k = 3L,
  bmf = TRUE,
  sn = NULL,
  evidence = NULL,
  core = NULL,
  names = NULL,
  bmf_data = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

years

Schedule N tax years. Ignored when sn is supplied.

path

Cache directory for all downloads.

rules

A merger_rules() object.

types

Transaction types that become merger cases.

recover_eins

Recover missing recipient EINs by name (recover_recipient_ein()).

pre, post

Years before and after the merger in the fiscal panel.

years_back

Years before the merger in the attribute tables.

ratios, fit, weights, smooth, k

Passed to merger_fiscal_panel().

bmf

Retrieve BMF traits (NTEE, ruling year) for attributes.

sn, evidence, core, names, bmf_data

Optional pre-fetched inputs.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

A list of class merger_data with sched_n (one row per Schedule N filing), cases, transfers, donors, recipients, part7, fiscal, transactions (asset lines), and manifest (row counts per stage).

Details

Pre-fetched inputs (sn, evidence, core, names, bmf_data) are used instead of retrieving them, which makes it possible to run the pipeline offline, for example on npmerger_example().

Examples

ex <- npmerger_example()
md <- build_merger_data(sn = ex$sn, evidence = ex$evidence, core = ex$core,
                        names = ex$names, bmf_data = ex$bmf, ratios = FALSE)
md
#> <merger_data>
#> Schedule N filings by type:
#>   merger2                  8
#>   asset_transfer           6
#>   closure                  6
#>   mergerN                  4
#>   consolidation            4
#>   asset_disposition        1
#> Tables:
#>   cases            16 rows
#>   transfers        16 rows
#>   donors           16 rows
#>   recipients       16 rows
#>   part7          1618 rows
#>   fiscal          166 rows
